_seeding_note: Reseeded 2026-07-29 from the per-shape MAX across 7 macos-latest CI runs (#116, #118-#123; ranges: solo 0.841-1.569ms, fanout3 0.652-1.587ms, burst 1.729-3.120ms, steady 1.218-2.838ms). The original seed sat at/below the observed MINIMUM, so the +30% ratio could not absorb normal runner variance and the gate flaked on healthy runs. Seeding at worst-observed-normal means the regression gate fires only when a run exceeds the slowest healthy runner by another 30%; the 100ms absolute gate (NFR2) is unaffected and stays 25-60x away.
